screen.findmyitems.config.title: findmyitems Config
screen.findmyitems.config.rescan_interva:
How often (in seconds) to re-scan nearby known chests.
0 = disabled. Single-player only.
screen.findmyitems.config.search_distanc:
Maximum distance (chunks) from player to re-scan chests.
0 = unlimited. Higher values impact performance.
screen.findmyitems.config.retrieve_dista:
How far away a container may be and still be taken from.
"Normal reach" is the range you could right-click it in.
Raising this never shortens your reach, and chunks that are
not loaded still cannot be reached into.
screen.findmyitems.config.index_ender.to:
Keep your ender chest contents indexed with no ender chest placed.
It is player data, so it costs no chunk loading. That stock is listed
as out of reach until you stand at an ender chest.
